prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling construction site. On the left, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands firmly on uneven ground. Beside him, near the center, lies a coiled orange extension cord resting loosely on the dirt. To the right, a foreman in a blue vest points decisively toward a stack of gray concrete blocks piled high against a half-built wall. Next to these blocks, a small black dog sits patiently, watching the activity with alert ears. In the background, slightly to the left of center, an engineer in a white shirt holds rolled-up blueprints tightly against her chest while looking at the foreman. Perched atop a wooden beam in the foreground right is a red toolbox, its lid slightly ajar. The worker in the yellow hard hat is handing a silver wrench to the engineer in the white shirt, bridging the gap between them. The foreman in the blue vest is looking at the small black dog, creating a momentary pause in his instructions. There is no heavy machinery visible in this intimate snapshot of manual labor and coordination.
